title: Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS)
summary: Implanted electrodes treating Parkinson's, OCD, depression — Medtronic, Abbott
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Implanted electrodes treating Parkinson's, OCD, depression — Medtronic, Abbott. Achieved.

Deployed at commercial scale with multiple competing vendors. Revenue-generating across the industry. Our research database tracks 3 independent sources on this technology.

FDA-approved for Parkinson's disease (2002), essential tremor, dystonia, and OCD; Medtronic Percept PC with sensing enabled closed-loop DBS since 2020. Over 200K patients implanted worldwide with 85%+ motor symptom improvement.
